# `bin`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the string representation of the long value `expr` represented in binary.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
bin(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bin, example 1
> SELECT bin(13);
1101
```

```sql
-- bin, example 2
> SELECT bin(-13);
1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111110011
```

```sql
-- bin, example 3
> SELECT bin(13.3);
1101
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
